svg.title: Set up Obsidian Publish
svg.desc: The production Publish to the web panel in Obsidian's right sidebar, beside placeholder note text. At the top, under the caption Website hosting service, the list of services shows Obsidian Publish with its icon, and a hairline the width of the pane ends the top. Under it, every step on one page, each a heading with its number and a period before its name over a rounded box of its own: 1. Create the files, with its Create files button, 2. Custom domain, with a button to Obsidian's help page, each on a line of its own with a hairline between them; then 3. Publish the two files and 4. All done. Nothing is dimmed, and nothing is written.
